title: Trapping Rain Water
prompt: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
hints: At each index, water trapped = min(maxLeft, maxRight) - height[i]. Water level is bounded by the shorter of the two sides.
Two pointers: left and right. Track maxLeft and maxRight. Water at current position depends on the smaller of the two maxes.
If maxLeft < maxRight, the water level at left is determined by maxLeft. Add water and move left. Symmetric for right.
O(n) time, O(1) space with two pointers. Alternative: precompute prefix max and suffix max arrays.
